materials.name: Structural timber

materials.name: Steel timber fixings

halfYearly: Exposed timber fixings (e.g. bolts and brackets)
tenYearly: Check exposed timber fixings for corrosion, repair as required.

materials.name: Mild steel
materials.b2Details: Protection for mild steel has been specified in accordance with SNZ TS 3404 – Durability requirements for steel structures and components and AS/NZS2312 – Guide to the protection of structural steel against atmospheric corrosion by the use of protective coatings. This guide works on a time to first maintenance basis and assumes on-going maintenance.

twentyFiveYearly: Inspect samples of structural steel that is hidden from view but not enclosed within a vapour barrier, and repair protective coatings as necessary. A typical example is a veranda with built-in steelwork. (Such steelwork should typically have duplex protective coatings). Inspection may typically require removal of claddings and/or the drilling of holes for borescope access. Repair as required.

materials.name: Reinforced masonry
materials.b2Details: Cover to reinforcing has been selected in accordance with NZS4229 and NZS4230
